title: Normalized rational projective-line kernel contractions
statement: For the rational coefficient E (or Qbar_l), a separated finite-type Y over a field of characteristic different from l, and the referenced completed diagonal family of def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference, let a be a pair of natural transformations of UnitCounitType from det-prop-p1-adjunction-rational-unit-counit. Assume UnitCounitNormalized: every component agrees, in heterogeneous equality, with the explicit ambient diagonal-class insertion unitComponent or inverse-projection/trace contraction counitComponent of def-sfb-projective-ambient-unit-counit-composites. On every M in Loc(Dbc(P1_Y,Lambda)), Rq_*(a.unit_M) followed by a.counit_(Rq_*M) equals Rq_* of identity_M tensor the support-normalized p1 diagonal integral. On every K in Loc(Dbc(Y,Lambda)), a.unit_(q*K(1)[2]) followed by q*(a.counit_K)(1)[2] equals identity_(q*K(1)[2]) tensor the support-normalized p2 diagonal integral. The tensor actions are conjugated by the right unitor and singleUnitIso. All canonical maps, coefficient lines, source normalizations, derived functors, completed limit data, and finite-type/Noetherian/localization hypotheses are exactly those in the attached Lean statement. The assertion is independent of the chosen normalized pair and does not assert integration, an adjunction, or a Brown comparison. The normalization fixes all map data; only the invertibility proofs are existential.

proof.text: For each M, expose the underlying Hom of the full-subcategory composite as Rq.map of (a.1.app M).hom followed by (a.2.app (push.obj M)).hom. The first projection of UnitCounitNormalized supplies unit normalization at M; its second supplies counit normalization at push.obj M. Apply [lem-sfb-rational-p1-first-ambient-contraction] to these two arrows, with an explicit ambient endomorphism type for the composite. This proves the first conjunct.

For each K, expose the underlying Hom of the second full-subcategory composite as the unit at exceptional.obj K followed by twist.map of pullback.map of the counit at K. The normalizations at exceptional.obj K and K follow from the corresponding projections of UnitCounitNormalized. Apply [lem-sfb-rational-p1-second-ambient-contraction] to K.obj and these two normalized arrows. The underlying object of exceptional.obj K is definitionally the positive twist/shift of q*K. Pair the two conjuncts.

proof_origin.place: Open componentwise normalization and use the separate first and second ambient contractions. The geometric calculations are retained in the two strictly smaller nodes.

theorem rationalP1_kernel_contractions
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (_hcompletion : DiagonalCompletionSpec l (diagonalSurface Y) D)
    (_hsystem : DiagonalCycleSystemSpec l Y hY D)
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (_hδ : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (family : Family l Y) (_reference : Reference l Y δ family)
    (a : UnitCounitType l c k p hpl Y)
    (_hnorm : UnitCounitNormalized l c k p hpl Y family a) :
    (∀ M : rationalLocalizingCategory (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y),
      ((push l c k p hpl Y).map (a.1.app M) ≫
        a.2.app ((push l c k p hpl Y).obj M)).hom =
      (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map
        (((ρ_ (M.obj)).inv ≫ ((M.obj) ◁
          ((singleUnitIso (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)).inv ≫
            (diagram l c Y family).support₁.hom ≫
            (diagram l c Y family).R₁.R.map (diagram l c Y family).delta ≫
            (diagram l c Y family).trace₁ ≫
            (singleUnitIso (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)).hom)) ≫ (ρ_ (M.obj)).hom))) ∧
    (∀ K : rationalLocalizingCategory (coefficient l c).X Y,
      (a.1.app ((exceptional l c k p hpl Y).obj K) ≫
        (exceptional l c k p hpl Y).map (a.2.app K)).hom =
      (ρ_ (((exceptional l c k p hpl Y).obj K).obj)).inv ≫
        ((((exceptional l c k p hpl Y).obj K).obj) ◁
          ((singleUnitIso (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)).inv ≫
            (diagram l c Y family).support₂.hom ≫
            (diagram l c Y family).R₂.R.map (diagram l c Y family).delta ≫
            (diagram l c Y family).trace₂ ≫
            (singleUnitIso (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)).hom)) ≫ 
        (ρ_ (((exceptional l c k p hpl Y).obj K).obj)).hom)
